messages:
sam_support: hey team, got a customer on a phone call — they accepted the org invite but when they open the console they immediately get a 403. says 'permission denied' even though invitation flow completed. any quick checks? :wave:

jess_support: ack. do we have customer/org ids? can you paste the user id + org id from the invite email?

sam_support: customer provided IDs in the session: user_id: u_0a1b2c, org_id: org_9x8y7z. they accepted via email about 10m ago. browser shows console UI but all routes 403.

jess_support: ok quick repro steps i want to try: 1) can you check admin > members to see if the user appears and what role is shown? 2) check 'Last provisioned' timestamp in the member row.

sam_support: did that on call — user appears in members list but role column is empty (shows "—"). last provisioned shows the same timestamp as acceptance.

jess_support: hmmm. that looks like invite completed, user created, but role mapping didn't attach. could be SCIM/SSO group mapping race or a post-provision job failure. escalating to identity team. @lisa_idp can you take a look?
lisa_idp: looking. can you grab the provisioning logs for org_id org_9x8y7z around ts 1832504300-1832504400? also is this a SAML SSO org or email-invite only?
sam_support: it's email-invite only (no SSO). logs attached from the customer session:```
HTTP 200 POST /api/v1/invite/accept - 1832504325
user_created id=u_0a1b2c
member_record created member_id=m_55aa
role_assign job enqueued job_id=job_992
job_992 status=completed
role_attach result=0 rows affected
```

lisa_idp: thanks. that log line "role_attach result=0 rows affected" is suspicious — indicates an attempted assignment that matched no role mapping. do we have default org role present?

ben_platform: jumping in — i can check the role catalog for that org. looking up org_9x8y7z... found roles: Owner, Admin, Viewer. default_invite_role is set to "Viewer" in org settings. so role exists.

lisa_idp: then why did role_attach affect 0 rows? probable reason: role_attach tries to match via membership->role_binding table keyed by (org_id, default_role_key). if member record was created with a transient temp_id that didn't match the key used by role job due to eventual consistency in the DB replica reads, job could run too early. we saw similar race on a few customers last month after the queue worker got faster.

jess_support: is there a quick support workaround we can give the customer while we fix the race?

lisa_idp: yes: manually assign the role from admin console (we can do it for them) or run the assign API as admin. admin API snippet:```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/orgs/org_9x8y7z/members/u_0a1b2c/roles" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"role":"Viewer"}'
```

sam_support: gave the curl to customer; they confirmed console access restored after admin role set. temporary fix works. customer asked if this will happen to others.

lisa_idp: creating internal ticket IDP-1123. root cause: role-assign job not retrying on zero-match when default role exists — race with eventual consistency window. plan: 1) add a transactional hook to role assignment that uses write-master confirmation before enqueuing job, 2) add a short retry/backoff for zero-match results, 3) backfill a repair job for recent acceptances.

ben_platform: i'll own backfill and the DB read path fix. will add a small migration to mark members missing a role and assign default. estimate: patch + canary deploy in 2 business days.

jess_support: thanks. i've notified customer and offered manual assignment (they accepted). i also gave them an ETA: 48 hours for permanent fix + repair of other affected users.

sam_support: customer appreciative but wants visibility — created support ticket SUP-2345 and asked for updates.

lisa_idp: adding to release notes and runbook: create check in support runbook for "invite accepted but no role" -> quick query to verify member.role is null and run assign_api. also log a distinct metric for role_attach zero_match occurrences.

ben_platform: rolled a quick internal dashboard metric for role_attach_zero_match = true counts. first alert threshold at > 5 events / hour. will hook to #eng-identity alerts.

jess_support: any blockers on the repair job?

ben_platform: none yet. will target a controlled backfill next morning, will run in read-only test first.

lisa_idp: test plan: simulate invite flow in staging with DB replica lag and confirm role job deterministically assigns role after fix. also add unit test verifying job retries on zero-match.

sam_support: customer confirmed no other users impacted for their org. closing on call for now. will add updates to SUP-2345 as progress is made.

jess_support: marking thread resolved for now. will reopen if backfill finds more issues. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: eng-identity/role-assign-fix v1.0.3 -> canary @ 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z (note: scheduled time in UTC).
